rows.value: Reasonable and Customary Charge = lowest of Actual Charge, Usual Charge, or Customary Charge at the 70th percentile of charges in the same geographic area as determined by MetLife
rows.quote: equal to the 70th percentile of charges as determined by MetLife based on charge
rows.notes: Full definition in consecutive pieces (def 50): 'Reasonable and Customary Charge is the lowest of: ● the Dentist's actual charge' / 'for the services or supplies (or, if the provider of the service or supplies is not' / 'a Dentist, such other provider's actual charge for the services or supplies) (the' / "'Actual Charge'); or ● the usual charge by the Dentist or other provider of the" / "services or supplies for the same or similar services or supplies (the 'Usual Charge');" / 'or ● the usual charge of other Dentists or other providers in the same geographic area' / 'equal to the 70th percentile of charges as determined by MetLife based on charge' / "information for the same or similar services or supplies maintained in MetLife's" / "Reasonable and Customary Charge records (the 'Customary Charge')." Confirms the ML26 preset's oon_rule quote. The High Option certificate (2018) uses the 80th percentile instead.

rows.value: Maximum Allowed Charge = lesser of the Dentist's charge or the amount the In-Network Dentist agreed with MetLife to accept as payment
rows.quote: the maximum amount which the In-Network Dentist has agreed with Us to accept as payment
rows.notes: Preceded by 'Maximum Allowed Charge means the lesser of: ● the amount charged by the Dentist; or ●'. The definition may continue beyond the captured pieces (e.g. 'in full for the Covered Service') — not captured.

rows.value: In-Network Dentist participates in the Preferred Dentist Program; Out-of-Network Dentist does not
rows.quote: In-Network Dentist means a Dentist who participates in the Preferred Dentist Program
rows.notes: Also def 49: 'Out-of-Network Dentist means a Dentist who does not participate in the Preferred' / 'Dentist Program.' The marketing name 'PDP Plus' appears only in the 2026 guide.

rows.quote: Year or Yearly, for Dental Insurance, means the 12 month period that begins January 1.
rows.notes: The ML26 preset cites this quote to 'page 1' with a note to confirm; the printed footer is 'def 50' (UNC edition: p.49).

rows.quote: and who, in each case, is under age 26 and supported
rows.notes: Preceding piece: 'Your natural or adopted child; Your stepchild; or a child who resides with and is fully' / 'supported by You; or a foster child;'. The remainder of the definition (disabled-child continuation etc.) was not captured. 'Spouse means Your lawful spouse.' (def 50).

rows.notes: Relevant to crown and cast_crown; the 2026 guide's exclusion 'Replacement of a lost of stolen appliance, Cast Restoration or Denture.' uses this defined term.

rows.value: Covered Service: dental service prescribed or performed by a Dentist while the person is insured (definition continues; remainder not captured)

rows.notes: Second piece: 'condition which is: ● prescribed or performed by a Dentist while such person is insured'. Remaining bullets (e.g. 'Dentally Necessary', 'described in the Description of Covered Services') not captured.

This appeared only in the second rider PDF (ncflex-dental-rider-high-and-classic-options112024); the first rider PDF (metlife-dental-rider-high-and-classic-options-1124) returned only the removable-appliance change. Establishes that implants are Type C Covered Services in the Classic and High certificates.

The 2026 guide's partial exclusion list (p.26) has no missing-tooth bullet; the certificate's full list was not reachable.
